findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler cannot be instantiated (abstract methods not implemented)
findings.body: The class `MetricAlertDetectorHandler(StatefulDetectorHandler[QuerySubscriptionUpdate])` body is just `pass`. With this PR, `StatefulDetectorHandler` adds `build_occurrence_and_event_data` as an `@abc.abstractmethod`, and it still requires the pre-existing abstract members `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, and `get_group_key_values`. None of these are implemented on `MetricAlertDetectorHandler`, so attempting to instantiate it (e.g., via `Detector.detector_handler` when `MetricAlertFire` is the group type, since `MetricAlertFire.detector_handler = MetricAlertDetectorHandler`) will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler with abstract methods ...`. The TODO comment hints this is a placeholder, but previously the class extended `DetectorHandler` and implemented `evaluate` returning `[]`, so it was actually instantiable — this PR regresses that. Either the new abstract method needs a default (e.g. raise `NotImplementedError`), or this stub class should be made `StatefulDetectorHandler`-ready (or removed from the registry) before merge.
